ruleDefinitions.name: Regsvr32 Execution From Potential Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a potentially suspicious location.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*")))
